title: Mother and Son Dressed Up, 1950s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-1950s snapshot depicting a mother and her young son posed outside on a suburban lawn. The boy is dressed in a suit with a boutonniere and carries a small prayer book, suggesting a First Communion or confirmation ceremony. His mother wears a polka dot dress with a light coat and holds a handbag. In the background, a tree-lined residential street features quiet suburban houses typical of post-WWII American neighborhoods.
